description: A committed record of one measured run that a docs/CLAIMS.yaml claim cites as evidence. The artifact file is hashed; the hash is recorded in docs/evidence/registry.json and in the citing claim. If the file changes, the gate fails. The drops manifest lists everything the run excluded (skipped tests, unmeasured versions, known flakes); a missing drops key makes the artifact incomplete and its claims fail.

badge.description: ACM artifact-badge vocabulary, adapted in-repo (see docs/evidence/README.md): available = artifact committed and hash-verified; functional = the gate re-ran the artifact's command successfully; reproduced = an independent run (CI) reproduced the numbers.

cited_content.description: Doc records only: the exact content the citing claim relies on (e.g. the license field, the CI matrix versions).

code_version.description: Full git SHA of the repo HEAD at run time.

command.description: The exact command that produced this run. For doc records, the verification act (reading the document and recording the cited content).

detector_version.description: Builtin detector version at run time (BuiltinHeuristicDetector.detector_version). Present only on records that exercise the detector; the gate fails claims whose record carries a detector version different from the current one.

document.description: Doc records only: repo-relative path of the document this record attests.

document_sha256.description: Doc records only: SHA-256 of the document at record time. The gate re-hashes the document; a changed document fails the claim until the record is refreshed.

drops.description: Drops manifest: everything this run excluded, each with a reason. The key must be present (an empty list means nothing was dropped); a missing key makes the artifact incomplete. Skipped tests, unmeasured Python versions, and known host flakes are recorded here, never silently omitted.

notes.description: Free-form notes for the human reader; never load-bearing for the gate.

results.description: Measured numbers from the run. Claims cite these through their numbers map; the gate compares claim numbers against this object.

run_date.description: ISO calendar date of the run. Claims citing a record older than 90 days fail as stale.

title: TextForensics run artifact (U7 claim-to-evidence gate)
